clusters.why: The area of the wound in question; the bearer is the subject, not part of the quality's name. Curator's notes: burn size = burn surface area = total burn area.
PATO size is the determinable over area, volume and length; untick here and tick under area if 'wound size' means its area.
The depth of the wound in question.
PATO length is not in the import modules; WONT's Length class is used.
PATO volume is not in the import modules; WONT's Volume class is used.
Three names for the amount of bacteria in the wound.
The age of the wound in question (PATO age).
